codeReview.summary: All three fixes are correctly implemented. The config.ts priority swap is minimal and correct (3-line reorder). Planning protocol additions for library population and milestone-specific validationCommands are clear and well-placed. Executing protocol retry/stuck-feature instructions add useful guidance. One non-blocking duplication issue found: the new RETRY AND STUCK FEATURE HANDLING section repeats two bullet points verbatim from the existing INTERVENTION PATTERNS section immediately below it.

issues.description: Duplication between RETRY AND STUCK FEATURE HANDLING and INTERVENTION PATTERNS sections. Two bullets are near-identical: (1) 'Feature fails twice → create a targeted fix feature addressing the specific failure' and (2) 'Feature exhausts retries (3x) → mark blocked, inform user clearly what went wrong and why' appear in both sections. This wastes LLM context tokens. The RETRY section adds 3 unique bullets (retry once on first failure, stuck active handling, move-on after fix), but the duplicate bullets should be removed from one section or the other.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Mission AGENTS.md already documents the updated validation command priority order (milestone-specific > config > plan > auto-detect), so shared state is consistent with the code change.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: AGENTS.md Conventions section: 'Validation command resolution priority: milestone-specific > config > plan > auto-detect.'
